top_signals.title: FTSE 100 Live: Stocks drop as US inflation woes outweigh soaring Nvidia sales
top_signals.summary: Welcome back to the City AM FTSE 100 liveblog. The UK’s blue chip has taken a battering in early trading, as murky US inflation data overshadowed Nvidia’s sales triumph. While headline inflation fell back, the Fed’s preferred measure – the Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index (PCE) – is still running hot at 3.7 per cent. [...]
